title: When the Land Goes Under the Water
author: Bruno Dias (as Nikephoros De Kloet)

archive.primary: When the Land Goes Under the Wa.gblorb

description:
The great, powerful elder empire of Atlantis has fallen, though accounts diverge on why. She will soon sink beneath the waves. But there is time, first, to sift through the ashes and catalog some of its tales.

When the Land Goes Under the Water is an exploratory piece meant to played only once.

An entry in ShuffleComp: Disc 2. Inspired by "What'cha Gonna Do" by Abigail Washburn and Bela Fleck.
